caption: Figure 1: The LLM Coordination Benchmark consists of two tasks: Agentic Coordination to study the holistic abilities of LLMs in multi-turn pure coordination games, and Coordination QA to perform a fine-grained analysis of the Environment Comprehension, Theory of Mind Reasoning, and Joint Planning abilities of LLMs in the context of pure coordination scenarios.
Figure 2: Correlation of LLM Agent performance in Agentic Coordination setup on all four games vs. performance on the CoordinationQA benchmark.

Figure3: The performance of different LLMs on CoordinationQA, which provides a fine-grained analysis of LLMs' Environment Comprehension, Theory of Mind Reasoning, and Joint Planning abilities within pure coordination scenarios.
Figure 4: The Overcooked layouts from left to right: Cramped Room (CR), Asymmetric Advantages (AA), Forced Coordination (FC), Coordination Ring (CR), and Counter Circuit (CC).
